assessment.honest_summary: The experiment now uses real external Claude Sonnet calls when LLM_API_KEY is available. Profile targets remain indirect because the public CoviPrev extract used here is national rather than fully stratified by socio-professional category, so the profile-level fit should be read as plausibility calibration rather than identification.
